decision.rule: Branch A if at least one above-chance model has a layer with T1 grouped-CV permutation p_holm < 0.01, Δρ vs stimulus >= 0.10 with CI excluding 0, and category- and confidence-residual CIs excluding 0.

holm_floor_note: n_perm=1000 implies minimum permutation p = 1/1001. Holm floor is n_layers/1001 (Qwen 0.036, Gemma 0.042, Molmo 0.032), all > 0.01. No layer can pass perm_holm_lt_0p01 under this n_perm. Rule not retuned.
